From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Production — sudden throughput drop + surge in 5xxs (region-us-east)

Quick tech readout: initial telemetry points to unexpected KV cache churn on the large-seq model variant. When prefixes miss, we see repeated full-attention passes that increase GPU run time and cause head-of-line blocking. Symptoms: transient queueing, token-generation timeouts => 503.

Immediate mitigations I’m putting in motion now:
- Activate the fallback model variant (reduced context / quantized) for the affected route to reduce per-request GPU cost (will lower quality on long-form only).
- Increase worker count on the dedicated pool for the next 30 minutes and open burst capacity. Aditya — please confirm you’ve started the scale-up.
- Flush problematic cache shards and monitor error rate.

I’ll post telemetry in the bridge; if scale-up doesn’t reduce 5xxs in 10 minutes we’ll fallback regionally and roll out stricter rate-limiting per customer key to protect the cluster.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

- Activating a conservative fallback model variant to reduce per-request latency at the cost of long-form quality.
- Flushing affected KV cache shards and closely monitoring error rates.
Estimated time to stabilization: 20–30 minutes. We will report back at 10:15 PDT with a telemetry snapshot.
If you have an urgent request id or job we should prioritize, please forward it to me now.
